scripts.verify:release: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('dist/installer-manifest.json'));const c=require('crypto');for(const [f,x] of Object.entries(m.files)){const b=fs.readFileSync('dist/'+f);if(b.length!==x.size||c.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex')!==x.sha256)throw new Error('release_integrity:'+f)}console.log(JSON.stringify({ok:true,installerVersion:m.installerVersion,files:Object.keys(m.files)}))"
